sentences.text:
Court No. - 83
Case :- Application U/S 483 No. - 2029 of 2024
Applicant :- Ruchi Bishnoi

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Abhishek Upadhyay,Shyam Shankar Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present application u/s 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed with prayer to direct the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Moradabad to decide/conclude the proceeding of Criminal Case No. 10339 of 2023, arising out of Case Crime No. 816 of 2022 under Sections 498A, 323 IPC and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Civil Lines, District Moradabad within stipulated period.

entities.text: Police Station Civil Lines, District Moradabad
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the matter is pending consideration before the court concerned.
Expeditious disposal of a case is the right of every litigant and it is expected from every Court to endeavour to dispose of a case pending before it, expeditiously.

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. has no objection in this regard.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and submission made by learned counsel for applicant, it is expedient to direct the court concerned to make its endeavour to decide the case as expeditiously as possible without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, if there is no other legal impediment.
With the aforesaid directions, the application stands disposed of finally.
